summary: Remove bundled NVIDIA documentation and raw model transcripts from release files while preserving pinned local source checks and explicit evidence provenance.

examined.reason: The exact same pinned source and section hashes are checked from a local-only cache; generated locators change path without changing the instruction-section partition.
All nine accepted forms, candidate bytes and source hashes remain unchanged; source location and public archive manifest hashes change explicitly, and revision fixtures verify the local vendor hash.
Update exact source-ledger passage links for the new local acquisition contract; original message-passing semantics, restrictions and proofs remain unchanged.
Separate proof and semantic acceptance remains unchanged; public evidence now explicitly scopes omitted vendor-bearing transcripts while preserving accepted patches and original identities.
Only vendor source links move to publisher URLs; scalar definitions and proof contracts are unchanged.

Acquire rather than redistribute the vendor manual; exact hash, size and anchor checks remain mandatory. Public records identify omitted raw transcripts and distinguish this current-tree cleanup from history publication.
Only source-navigation URLs changed; allocation, permissions, memory model and proofs remain unchanged.
Provision exact task-declared local source before builds without implicit fetching; preserve hash and drift checks, candidate edit boundaries, and zero-call preparation.
Fresh replay restores source from a verified local cache tied to a committed manifest; retained patch and receipt bytes and original recorded task identities are unchanged.

Add one narrowly scoped local-only PTX input bound to an immutable manifest; check after dispatch and exclude only that input from patch capture. Public archives explicitly omit raw transcripts with original hashes rather than claiming complete logs.
Only provenance acquisition and public evidence packaging change. Pinned PTX interpretation, permitted-execution definitions, all Lean code and proved obligations are unchanged.

results.method: Full scripts/check.sh and integration/torchlean/check.sh; direct pinned publisher download; retained-archive byte comparison; distribution guard and 24-word vendor-passage scan; stratic validate; git diff --check
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0; actual NVIDIA HTML acquired into ignored .ptx-source cache and verified by original SHA256; no model calls
results.evidence: Root checks passed: 87 worker/acquisition/evidence tests, 26 ledger tests, 7 inventory tests, 9 accepted forms, all public evidence manifests, full build and 1213 dependency reports. Integration passed 363 dependency reports. Real publisher download still matches original 3928316-byte hash. All five transformed archives preserve every retained member exactly; 14 raw event transcripts omitted with original size/hash provenance and private originals retained locally. No current tracked artifact is the full manual or a raw transcript; targeted paragraph scan found no 24-word manual match in remaining tracked text/archive members. This guard is not a copyright judgment or exhaustive quotation audit. Git history is explicitly NOT cleaned: 23 local commits beyond remote main still need a separately authorized rewrite. The checked snapshot is unchanged. Logs /tmp/ptx-source-cleanup-check.log and /tmp/ptx-source-cleanup-integration.log.

unmapped.reason: Preserved user-edited introduction and examples; added explicit verified manual acquisition and removed the bundled-documentation license statement.
